title: Synaptic
description: I had a thousand loose notes and none in their place, so I built the app I wanted: dump raw text, photos or voice notes and AI turns them into structured pages, a concept map per topic and short daily reviews of what you haven't mastered yet. Built solo end-to-end, it now has real users and is starting to earn subscription revenue.

title: Cadence
description: For people with too many interests to fit in one app: agenda, routines, home chores, reading, movement and quick expenses in one calm, mobile-first PWA. An AI assistant turns what you say or type into tasks and expenses you confirm. Auth.js sign-in, Zod validation and Vitest tests.

title: Lagoa · Estudio digital
description: My freelance studio. Small businesses don't buy 'a website', they buy bookings, answered messages and customers who find them. So every service — bookings, WhatsApp assistant, online shop, Google Maps — comes with a live demo you can try before hiring.

title: Yutori Espacio Creativo
description: Client project for a creative workshop space in A Coruña: watercolour, crochet, sewing and embroidery classes, monthly workshops, private sessions and gift vouchers, plus an admin panel so the owner updates everything herself. Built with Astro and deployed on Cloudflare Workers.

title: Iago · Asesor fiscal
description: Client project for an online tax advisor whose pitch is 'no jargon, no rush': tax returns, self-employed paperwork, inheritances, grants and bank offers explained in plain words. Bilingual (ES/CA), with playful draggable stickers to keep a dry topic friendly.
